criteria.name: Contrast (minimum)
criteria.evidence: axe color-contrast passes on all 6 stories

criteria.name: Reflow
criteria.evidence: scroll width: the open panel (260px, default offsets) runs past the viewport, 360px at 320 wide and 395px at 390
criteria.note: Heal (a11y): use mobileWidth and mobile offsets by default so the panel stays on screen.

criteria.name: Text spacing
criteria.evidence: text spacing override (line height 1.5, letter 0.12em, word 0.16em, paragraph 2em) on Default and LongContent: no clipped text

criteria.name: Keyboard
criteria.evidence: Keyboard story (play): Tab moves through the items in order, Shift+Tab back; source: Escape (keyup) closes through ClickOutside

criteria.name: Focus order
criteria.evidence: source: opening does not move focus into the panel and closing does not return it to the trigger
criteria.note: Whether that order works depends on the trigger each page uses; a person should try one real menu.

criteria.name: Focus visible
criteria.evidence: keyboard run: each item gets a 2px #000 outline

criteria.name: Focus not obscured (minimum)
criteria.evidence: screenshots: the panel does not cover its own focused item

criteria.name: Consistent help
criteria.evidence: page level: the component offers no help mechanism

criteria.name: Redundant entry
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component asks for no data

criteria.name: Accessible authentication (minimum)
criteria.evidence: flow level: the component is not part of a login step

criteria.name: Name, role, value
criteria.evidence: axe passes on all 6 stories: items are buttons named by their text
criteria.note: No menu or list role; the trigger's aria-expanded is the caller's.
